0022600152.text: The Timberwolves (4-2, 3rd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back) head into the 7th game of their season on a one-game win streak and a 2-1 road record, while the Spurs (3-2, 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back) arrive on a three-game win streak with a 1-2 home record. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery) and Rudy Gobert (back spasms), and San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), with Stephon Castle listed as day-to-day with a mild head injury and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 regular-season series 2-1 in the Timberwolves' favor, but San Antonio's most recent meeting was a 2026 playoff game in Minneapolis, where the Timberwolves lost 139-109 in a series they lost 4-2.
